trigger: AUTH_UNAVAILABLE 503 or RATE_LIMITED 429 during existing scheduler validation
calendar: scheduler every 10 seconds; persisted rechecks after 30, 60, 120, 240, 300 seconds
expected_signal: live owner validation succeeds before dispatch; closed wait reason clears
symptom: technical scheduler pause or stale transient-control recheck
repair: restore identity dependency; explicitly restart an old permanent pause through domain guards
rollback: previous verified StoryFX backend release and SQLite backup
illustrated_alert: existing StoryFX control incident template, existing global two-hour notification quota
publication_retry: explicit only; preserve confirmed, uncertain, previously retried and original audit
